title: Traditional and Customary Practices Report for Manaʻe, Molokaʻi
lineage: Paraphrased research notes, not a source copy.

passages.note: The report describes Hui o Kuapā – Keawanui Fishpond, formerly known as the Hawaiian Learning Center, restoring and maintaining Keawanui since 1999 and using the site for education. It is based on community-engagement work and does not date original construction.
